name: EPIC 206085180
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 4.1 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206085180 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 4.13701 (16th-84th percentiles 4.062117-4.240546), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206085180 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.880502 (16th-84th percentiles 0.844296-0.933797), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206085180: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4820.7524 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206085180 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1423.59375 (16th-84th percentiles 1399.941406-1452.382812), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,424 parsecs away, 4 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.88 solar masses and 4.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,821 K at its surface.
